verdict.rationale: Galileo ships AI-generated evaluation insights (LLM-as-a-judge metrics, hallucination/factuality detection, agentic metrics, alerting on anomalies) and an 'AI Assistant' for troubleshooting agentic systems built into the console, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: deeper documentation/detail on the AI Assistant's suggestion capabilities beyond a single release-note line, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the insight quality.
